text: As the Patriots prepare to head to Miami for a Week 8 AFC East showdown, Drake Maye's exceptional scramble-drill efficiency—he's pacing the league in passing yards on broken plays—figures to be central to New England's gameplan, though the secondary will need to stay sharp against a Dolphins team looking to build momentum behind Willis, their former coach. The injury report brings some complications: A.J. Brown, freshly back from injured reserve, has already missed Thursday practice with a new knee ailment compounding his previously injured ankle, casting uncertainty over his availability for Sunday. The secondary itself is expected to be healthy, offering at least one bright spot in the injury picture as the Patriots look for their third AFC East win of the season, with experts weighing the matchup as part of their Week 8 picks and survivor pool strategy.
